description: Use this only when the person asks what a received fax says, or to summarize it. Returns its pages as images, up to 10. It marks the fax read for the person. Don't repeat medical or legal contents beyond what the person needs. Needs the person to sign in to Faxette.

organization.description: The organization's id from get_organizations. Ask the person which one if there are several.

name: read_inbound_fax
title: Read a received fax
